en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, from Humran, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘For everything is an outcome, and the outcome of the act of kindness is a quick relief’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Khalaf ibn Hammad from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurarah from Humran who has said the following: “I heard abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ’
Everything has a fruit. The fruit of Benevolent Assistance is its quick release.”’
